lead_raw_text:
The structure of Na6Li3Cu3Cl18 (reduced formula Na2LiCuCl6) is trigonal, space group R-3m (No. 166), with 30 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li and Cu each adopt octahedral coordination by six Cl neighbors, while Na has a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Cl neighbors. Corner-sharing between Li- and Cu-centered octahedra and face-sharing between Na-centered 12-vertex polyhedra and Li/Cu octahedra are observed. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 30 sites.
